process_area.title: Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup

value_stream.name: Blueprint, Reprographics & Large-Format Plan Printing Services

fields.Owner: Director, Store Services / Trade Pro & Services (VS-43)
fields.Participants: Strategy (VS-33), Trade Pro (VS-43), Merchandising (VS-01), Marketing (VS-14), FP&A (VS-17.4), Legal/Compliance (VS-100/VS-91), IT (VS-27)
fields.Trigger: Strategy refresh (VS-33); B2B/trade-pro program (VS-43); new service launch

workflows.name: Reprographics Service Strategy, Catalog & Business-Model Design

Automation Opportunity: - Trade-density-based site-suitability scoring; business-case template tied to B2B actuals
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: business case leadership-approved (VS-36); legal/privacy posture defined (VS-100/VS-91); economics FP&A-validated
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-43/VS-11 (trade/B2B), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-100/VS-91 (legal/privacy); W5082 (equipment), W5083 (pricing), W5087 (IP/confidentiality)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Demand-misread risk**: Deploying equipment where B2B trade volume won't sustain it; mitigated by trade-density-based rollout
- **Legal/compliance risk**: Copyright/IP and RA 10173 exposure mishandled; mitigated by Legal/Compliance posture at step 3 (W5087)
- **Margin-illusion risk**: Margin eroded by hidden consumables/equipment cost; mitigated by fully-burdened unit-economics (W5083)
System Touchpoints: - FP&A/strategy (VS-17.4/VS-33); trade-pro/B2B (VS-43/VS-11); merchandising (VS-01); legal (VS-100); privacy (VS-91); print-management system (new — W5086); IT (VS-27)
Time Estimate: - ~4–6 weeks annual strategy + per-store business case

steps.activity: Set the reprographics strategy & catalog: the service catalog (large-format plan print/scan/copy, bid-set/plan-room, binding/folding, archiving), the rollout (which high-trade-density stores), the make-vs-partner/3PL model, and the KPIs (job volume, margin, attach, uptime)
steps.r: Director Store Services / Trade Pro / Strategy

steps.activity: Build the business case: equipment capex, consumables cost, breakeven job volume, payback, and the trade-pro-traffic/attach linkage to B2B revenue (links VS-11/VS-43) with FP&A
Govern & approve: leadership sign-off (VS-36), the legal/compliance posture (copyright/IP, RA 10173 document confidentiality — W5087), and the entity placement with Legal/Compliance

fields.Participants: Procurement (VS-34), IT/IT-Asset (VS-99), Finance/Fixed-Asset (VS-35), Facilities (VS-138), vendor, Store Ops (VS-07)
fields.Trigger: Strategy approval (W5081); new site; equipment refresh
fields.Volume: ~1 plotter + 1 large-format scanner per service site

workflows.name: Large-Format Printer/Plotter/Scanner Equipment Selection, Procurement & Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Equipment-ROI model; auto-calibration scheduling (VS-115); network-integration acceptance checklist
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: equipment within VS-35/VS-34 capex matrix; calibrated (VS-115); IT-acceptance before go-live; staff trained (VS-19.4)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-35/VS-99 (assets), VS-27 (IT), VS-138 (facilities), VS-115 (calibration); W5081 (strategy), W5086 (software), W5088 (maintenance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-spec risk**: Equipment that can't handle CAD/GIS volume/quality; mitigated by spec driven by catalog/demand
- **Network/integration risk**: Plotter not integrated to submission portal (W5086); mitigated by IT acceptance
- **Capital-tie-up risk**: Over-investment in low-demand sites; mitigated by W5081 rollout discipline
System Touchpoints: - Procurement (VS-34); fixed-asset/IT-asset (VS-35/VS-99); IT network (VS-27); facilities (VS-138); calibration/metrology (VS-115); print-management software (W5086); training (VS-19.4)

steps.activity: Specify & select equipment: large-format inkjet plotter (A0/A1, CAD/GIS), large-format scanner, finishing (folder/binder), spec (speed, media width, color accuracy, network/cloud), and vendor evaluation
Procure & install: PO (VS-34), fixed-asset capitalise (VS-35), install/network-integrate (VS-27/VS-99), counter layout & ventilation (VS-138), and acceptance test
Commission & handover: calibrate (VS-115), load the print-management system/software (W5086), train counter staff (VS-19.4), and go-live sign-off

fields.Participants: Pricing (VS-01.2), FP&A (VS-17.4), Trade Pro (VS-43), Marketing (VS-14), Compliance (price-integrity VS-118)
fields.Trigger: Service launch (W5081); cost change; pricing review
fields.Volume: ~20–30 tariff lines per service (print/scan/copy/binding/archiving) × media type

workflows.name: Reprographics Pricing, Cost-per-SQM & Service Tariff Strategy

Automation Opportunity: - Cost-per-sqm calculator tied to consumables data (W5084); competitive-rate scraping; margin dashboard
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: pricing cost-based & FP&A-approved; RA 7394 all-in disclosure (VS-118); discounts margin-controlled
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-118 (integrity), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-158 (cost); W5084 (consumables), W5099 (margin analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-pricing risk**: Tariff below cost-per-sqm → margin loss; mitigated by cost-based pricing
- **Price-integrity risk**: Undisclosed fees → RA 7394 exposure; mitigated by all-in disclosure (VS-118)
- **Cost-volatility risk**: Ink/media cost rise not passed through; mitigated by cost-linked pricing
System Touchpoints: - Pricing/tariff engine (VS-01.2); POS (VS-08); price-integrity (VS-118); loyalty/member (VS-13); cost/consumables (VS-158); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Set the tariff & cost model: cost-per-sqm (media + ink + machine + labor + overhead), tariff by service (print/scan/copy/binding/archiving), media-type/size tiers, and volume/bulk-account discounting
Ensure price integrity & disclosure: all-in price disclosure (RA 7394), price-list/rate-card at counter & online, and trade-pro/member pricing consistency (VS-13)
Link to analytics: feed cost-consumption (W5084), margin analytics (W5099), competitive positioning, and promotions (VS-14)

fields.Participants: Procurement (VS-34), Inventory (VS-05), Store Services Lead, Supplier (VS-03), FP&A (cost — VS-17.4)
fields.Volume: ~200–400 SKUs of media rolls/sheets + ink/toner + binding supplies across ~15–25 service sites

workflows.name: Print Media, Toner/Ink & Consumables Procurement & Inventory Management

Automation Opportunity: - Min-max auto-replenishment; consumables-yield auto-accounting; expiry-FIFO control
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: min-max controlled; expiry/FIFO enforced; consumption reconciled to jobs (W5099)
Cross-references: - links to VS-05 (inventory), VS-34/VS-03 (procurement/suppliers), VS-158 (cost); W5082 (equipment), W5083 (pricing), W5099 (yield analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stock-out risk**: Ink/media out → service downtime & customer loss; mitigated by min-max + safety stock
- **Shelf-life risk**: Expired media/ink → print defects/waste; mitigated by FIFO/expiry control
- **Cost-leakage risk**: Untracked consumables → margin illusion; mitigated by consumption-to-job cost accounting (W5099)
System Touchpoints: - Inventory (VS-05); procurement (VS-34); supplier mgmt (VS-03); cost/landed (VS-158); consumables-yield analytics (W5099); FP&A (VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Manage the consumables catalog & sourcing: media (bond/vellum/photo/matte, widths/sizes), ink/toner cartridges, binding/folding supplies, supplier selection and pricing (links VS-03)
Control inventory & replenishment: min-max per site, scan-based receiving (VS-05), expiry/shelf-life for media/ink, and replenishment triggered by consumption (W5099)
Reconcile & report: consumables consumption vs jobs (cost accounting W5099), shrink/damage, and feed cost analytics (VS-158/VS-17.4)

fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), Facilities (VS-138), IT (VS-27), HSE (VS-24), Trade Pro (VS-43), Store Manager

workflows.name: Reprographics Service Counter, Layout & Self-Service Workstation Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Self-service kiosk workflow; accessible-design checklist; ventilation/BFP auto-verification
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: counter BFP/OSH-compliant (VS-166/VS-24); PWD-accessible (BP 344); ventilation adequate
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (store ops), VS-138 (IFM), VS-24/VS-166 (HSE/permits), VS-43 (trade-pro); W5081 (strategy), W5086 (portal), W5088 (maintenance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Workflow-bottleneck risk**: Poor counter layout → queue/customer friction; mitigated by layout design
- **Accessibility risk**: Counter not PWD-accessible (BP 344/RA 7277); mitigated by accessible design
- **Ventilation/fire risk**: Plotter heat/emissions in confined space; mitigated by ventilation + BFP sign-off
System Touchpoints: - Facilities/IFM (VS-138); store ops (VS-07); IT (VS-27); HSE/fire (VS-24/VS-166); print-management (W5086); accessibility (BP 344)

steps.a: Director Store Services / VP Store Operations
steps.activity: Design the service counter & layout: counter location (near trade-pro/pro-desk VS-43), customer file-review/workstation area, finishing area (folder/binder), ventilation, and BFP/OSH egress (links VS-138/VS-24)
steps.r: Facilities / Store Ops / Director Store Services

steps.activity: Set up self-service workstations: customer submit/preview/payment workstation, cloud/mobile integration (W5086), secure document handling station, and accessibility (BP 344/RA 7277)
Commission & staff: HSE/fire sign-off (VS-24/VS-166), staff the counter, and go-live with the print-management system (W5086)
steps.r: Director Store Services / HSE / Store Ops

fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), Digital Commerce (VS-10), Trade Pro (VS-43), Legal/Privacy (VS-100/VS-91), Customer Service (VS-13)
fields.Trigger: Service launch (W5081); IT capability; customer-demand for remote submission
fields.Volume: ~70–90% of jobs submitted via the portal at maturity

Automation Opportunity: - Auto pre-flight/quoting on upload; encrypted transfer; retention auto-purge (W5100)
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: encrypted upload/transfer (VS-27); RA 10173 consent (VS-91); retention/disposal policy (W5100); copyright controls (W5087)
Cross-references: - links to VS-10/VS-75 (digital), VS-27 (IT security), VS-91 (privacy), VS-100 (IP); W5089 (intake/quoting), W5096 (billing), W5100 (confidentiality)
Pain Points / Risks: - **File-format risk**: Unsupported/corrupt files → failed jobs; mitigated by pre-flight check & format standard
- **Data-breach risk**: Customer plan data exposed (RA 10173); mitigated by encryption + retention controls (W5100)
- **Adoption risk**: Low portal adoption → manual intake overhead; mitigated by UX + trade-pro onboarding
System Touchpoints: - Web/mobile portal (VS-10/VS-75); print-management software; IT security (VS-27); privacy/consent (VS-91); O2C/prepaid (W5096); CRM (VS-13)

steps.activity: Deploy the print-submission portal: web/mobile upload (links VS-10/VS-75), account/prepaid integration (W5096), file preview & job-quoting (W5089), and store-routing to the destination counter
Standardize file formats & QA: supported formats (PDF/TIFF/DWG/DXF), pre-flight check (scale/size/color), file-corruption handling, and the auto-quoting feed to intake (W5089)
Govern security & data handling: encrypted upload/transfer, RA 10173 consent, retention/disposal policy (W5100), and IP/copyright controls (W5087) with Legal/Privacy

fields.Participants: Legal (VS-100), Compliance (VS-22), Privacy (VS-91), IT (VS-27), Store Services Lead
fields.Trigger: Service launch (W5081); legal refresh; sensitive-document job
fields.Volume: 1 confidentiality/retention policy across all reprographics jobs

workflows.name: Copyright, IP & Sensitive-Document Handling Policy & Controls

Automation Opportunity: - Intake attestation e-capture; chain-of-custody tracking; auto-secure-disposal (W5100)
Controls: - CTL-758: customer authorship attestation at intake; RA 8293/RA 10173 policy (Legal); sealed-bid protocol; secure disposal (W5100); staff trained (VS-19.4)
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal/IP), VS-91 (privacy), VS-22 (compliance), VS-21 (audit); W5089 (intake), W5100 (confidentiality/disposal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Copyright-infringement risk**: Reproducing infringing material → RA 8293 liability; mitigated by attestation + refusal policy
- **Confidentiality-breach risk**: Bid/personal-document leak → RA 10173/contract breach; mitigated by chain-of-custody + secure disposal (W5100)
- **Sealed-bid-integrity risk**: Mishandling government sealed bids (RA 9184); mitigated by sealed-bid protocol
System Touchpoints: - Legal/compliance (VS-100/VS-22); privacy (VS-91); print-management attestation (W5089); secure disposal (W5100); training (VS-19.4); audit (VS-21)

steps.a: Director Store Services / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Define the IP/copyright policy: customer-authorship attestation, refusal of obviously-infringing/infringing-third-party material (RA 8293 IP Code), and architect/engineer-signed-document handling

steps.a: Director Store Services / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Define sensitive-document handling: government-bid/sealed-bid confidentiality, personal-data plans (RA 10173), chain-of-custody, secure storage, and secure disposal/shred (W5100)
Operationalize & train: counter attestation at intake (W5089), staff training (VS-19.4), incident/breach handling (VS-91), and audit (VS-21)

fields.Participants: Facilities (VS-138), IT (VS-27/VS-99), Metrology/Calibration (VS-115), Vendor service, Store Services Lead
fields.Trigger: PM cycle; equipment install (W5082); breakdown; calibration due

workflows.name: Equipment Maintenance, Vendor Service Contract & Calibration Management

Automation Opportunity: - CMMS PM auto-generation; calibration-due alert (VS-115); downtime/auto-reliability analytics (W5098)
Controls: - CTL-758 (ensure controlled execution — Reprographics Service Strategy, Equipment & Catalog Setup (PA-176.1).)
- CTL-758: vendor SLA in contract; PM schedule adherence (VS-138); calibration current (VS-115)
Cross-references: - links to VS-138 (CMMS), VS-99 (IT asset), VS-115 (calibration), VS-03 (vendor); W5082 (equipment), W5097 (quality), W5098 (performance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Downtime risk**: Plotter/scanner down → service outage (critical on bid day); mitigated by SLA + PM + substitute capacity
- **Calibration-drift risk**: Scale/color inaccuracy → defective prints (W5097); mitigated by calibration (VS-115)
- **Contract-risk**: Weak SLA → slow recovery; mitigated by SLA terms
System Touchpoints: - Facility/CMMS (VS-138); IT-asset (VS-99); calibration/metrology (VS-115); vendor mgmt (VS-03); print-management (W5086); downtime analytics (W5098)

steps.activity: Maintain the vendor service contract: plotter/scanner maintenance contract, response-time SLA, parts supply, and contract management (links VS-03)
Execute scheduled PM & calibration: print-head cleaning, alignment, color/scale calibration (VS-115), scanner accuracy, and the PM cycle on finishing equipment
Manage reactive/breakdown: breakdown response, substitute capacity/3PL, and feed downtime analytics (W5098) + reliability improvement
